description: Deterministic visual projection compiled from SourceSceneIR. This is not a second gameplay semantic source: scene, model, UI, phase visual state, guidance, and CTA visuals must remain hash-bound to SourceSceneIR.

visual.scene: Camera, ground, lights, grid, background, and coordinate-system values projected from SourceSceneIR.scene.
visual.entities: Stable entity visuals. Each entry includes id, label, kind, transform, material, meshOps, and optional asset binding.
visual.hud: HUD visual contract projected from SourceSceneIR.hud, including tip source, resource bar, DOM HUD contract, and UI overlay contract.
visual.phaseStates: Per-phase visual state: visible entities, hidden entities, HUD text, target sequence, guidance target, resource hints, and CTA visibility.
visual.guidance: Guidance visuals such as target ring, trail line, laser line, and phase primary targets.
visual.cta: Final CTA visual contract, including entity, arrival-gated flag, title, button text, subtitle, and final phase.

preflightRules: source.sourceSceneIrHash must match the SourceSceneIR semanticHash used to compile it
visual.phaseStates[] ids must be unique and sequential as phase1..phaseN
visual.phaseStates[].visibleEntities and guidance targets must reference visual.entities[]
visual.cta.entity must reference visual.entities[] when present
semanticHash, when present, must match the normalized semantic payload
